entries.title: A merge GitHub holds for a rule you may skip comes back as a card to merge past it
entries.body: When you click Merge and GitHub refuses it for a branch rule your GitHub sign-in is allowed to skip, such as a required approval, your crewmate now puts up the card that merges past that rule, naming each rule it skips. You no longer have to ask for it in your own words, and nothing merges past a rule until you click.
entries.noPicture: The card that comes up is the existing merge card that skips the branch rules; only when it appears changes.
